splits.rationale: Both Soldier sources share footage and belong to the same split. Jack/Steve sparse overviews are inspected for inventory; their examples are reserved for evaluation rather than tuning. Holdout labelling and dense review remain pending.

policy.evidence: Six independently sought original frames per side; chronological contact sheets reviewed. Original PTS and extraction logs retained. Sparse examples do not estimate exhaustive recall or overall precision.
policy.nearby: Useful similarities excluded by the existing 12-second same-source setting are counted as policy exclusions, not silently included in the default acceptance recall denominator.
policy.shortAction: A true action parallel can fail the current support policy. Do not reinterpret a held endpoint as a repeated movement or count footage beyond a shot boundary as temporal support.
policy.hit: Swapped A/B allowed. Representative timestamps must fall in the corresponding verified ranges; overlapping export context alone is insufficient.
policy.crossSource: Evaluate only when both relevant sources are loaded; identity-independent structural evidence is a distinct evaluation scope from same-person search.
